general.name: General Questions
general.description: Orders, shipping, returns, account, and common customer questions.

faqs.question: What is the return window for products?
faqs.answer: Customers can request a return within 14 days of delivery for eligible items.

faqs.question: Are food items returnable?
faqs.answer: Yes, food items can be returned if they are unopened, in their original packaging, or arrived damaged.

faqs.question: Can opened products be returned?
faqs.answer: No. For health, safety, and hygiene reasons, opened food products or used spices cannot be returned.

faqs.question: Who pays for return shipping costs?
faqs.answer: If the item is damaged or incorrect, the platform/seller covers shipping. For change-of-mind returns, the customer pays.

faqs.question: How long do refunds take to process?
faqs.answer: Once approved, refunds take 5 to 7 business days to reflect in your original payment method.

faqs.question: Can customers exchange products?
faqs.answer: Exchanges are permitted for non-perishable food items and unopened kitchen appliances within the 14-day window.

faqs.question: What happens if a product arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: The platform will handle it immediately. Take a photo and contact support within 48 hours for a replacement or refund.

faqs.question: Who is responsible for lost packages during transit?
faqs.answer: The Platform handles logistics security and assumes full responsibility for packages lost by our delivery partners.

faqs.question: Can customers track their orders?
faqs.answer: Yes, a tracking link is automatically emailed as soon as the package leaves the store keeper.

faqs.question: Can I change my delivery address after placing an order?
faqs.answer: No. Once an order is confirmed, the shipping address cannot be modified for security and fraud prevention reasons.

faqs.question: What happens if a customer misses their delivery?
faqs.answer: The package is returned to the store keeper, and the payment is refunded to the customer's account.

faqs.question: Do you offer international shipping?
faqs.answer: No, we do not offer international shipping at this time (Policy pending internal discussion with Furkan).

faqs.question: Can users delete their accounts?
faqs.answer: Yes, users can permanently delete their accounts and wipe their personal profiles through their account settings page.

faqs.question: What should I do if my account is hacked?
faqs.answer: Contact platform support immediately. We will lock the account, clear active sessions, and help you regain secure access.

faqs.question: What is the password reset process?
faqs.answer: Click "Forgot Password" on the login screen to receive a secure recovery and reset link through your registered email.

faqs.question: How is my personal customer data protected?
faqs.answer: We strictly follow GDPR data privacy rules, using industry-standard encryption to keep all payment and personal details safe.

faqs.question: What are the age restrictions for using this platform?
faqs.answer: Users must be 13 years of age or older to create an account and place orders on our platform.

faqs.question: What is your process for preventing transaction fraud?
faqs.answer: We use automated payment screening, secure checkout layers, and manual verification for high-value orders.

faqs.question: Where can I view your complete Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy?
faqs.answer: Links to our full Terms, Conditions, and GDPR-compliant Privacy Policies are permanently accessible in the website footer. LINK?

faqs.question: How is VAT and tax handled on orders?
faqs.answer: Taxes are automatically calculated and applied at checkout according to local state and country Tax Laws.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Once your package leaves our facility, you will receive an email with a live tracking link. You can also view your order status at any time by logging into your account dashboard.

faqs.question: What happens if my package is lost in transit?
faqs.answer: You don't need to worry! Our platform takes full responsibility for packages lost by our courier partners. If your tracking hasn't updated or your package is declared lost, contact support immediately for a full replacement or refund.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss my delivery?
faqs.answer: If the courier is unable to deliver your package, it will be returned to our store keeper. Once we receive the returned package, your original payment method will be automatically refunded (minus any applicable shipping fees).

faqs.question: What is your return policy?
faqs.answer: We offer a 14-day return window from the date of delivery. To be eligible for a return, items must be in their original, unused condition and in the original packaging.

faqs.question: Can I return opened food or spice products?
faqs.answer: No. Due to strict health, safety, and hygiene regulations, we cannot accept returns on opened food items, unsealed spices, or used kitchen appliances.

faqs.question: What should I do if my item arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: We apologize if your order didn't arrive in perfect condition! Please take a clear photo of the damaged product and the packaging, and send it to our support team within 48 hours of delivery. We will issue a replacement or a full refund immediately.

faqs.question: Who pays for return shipping?
faqs.answer: If the return is due to an error on our end (such as a damaged or incorrect item), the platform covers all return shipping costs. For standard change-of-mind returns, the customer is responsible for the return shipping fees.

faqs.question: How long does it take to receive my refund?
faqs.answer: Once your returned item is received and inspected by our warehouse, your refund will be processed. It typically takes 5 to 7 business days for the funds to appear in your original bank account or on your credit card.

faqs.question: Where do your spices come from?
faqs.answer: All of our spices are authentically sourced directly from trusted organic farms across India and Pakistan, ensuring traditional flavor profiles and high quality.

faqs.question: Are your spices completely natural?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our spices are certified organic and contain zero artificial colors, dyes, or preservatives. You are purchasing 100% pure whole or ground spices.

faqs.question: How do you guarantee the freshness of packaged foods?
faqs.answer: Our inventory system strictly monitors expiration dates. We guarantee that all packaged foods and beverages shipped to you will have a minimum of 6 months remaining on their shelf life.

faqs.question: Are there Halal, vegan, or gluten-free options available?
faqs.answer: Yes! Many of our products cater to specific dietary needs. You can easily find these items by using the dietary filters on our category pages. Specific certifications (like Halal) are also clearly visible on the product packaging photos.

faqs.question: Do your kitchen appliances come with a warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes, all electrical kitchen appliances sold on Asian Spices come with a standard 1-year manufacturer’s warranty, which covers mechanical and electrical defects.

faqs.question: Are the appliances compatible with my local voltage?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every appliance listed on our site is specifically manufactured with the correct plugs and standard voltage specifications for local use—no power converters are required.

faqs.question: Can I return an appliance if I simply change my mind?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as the appliance is completely unboxed, unused, and returned within our 14-day return window. Once an appliance has been used, it is only covered under the manufacturer's warranty for defects.

faqs.question: Is my payment information safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. We strictly adhere to GDPR compliance rules. All personal and payment data is protected using industry-standard SSL encryption. We do not store your raw credit card data on our servers.

faqs.question: What should I do if I forget my password or my account is compromised?
faqs.answer: Simply click "Forgot Password" on the login page to receive a secure reset link via email. If you suspect your account has been hacked, contact our support team immediately so we can lock the account and help you regain secure access.

faqs.question: Are there any age restrictions for using the website?
faqs.answer: Yes, users must be at least 13 years of age to create an account and place orders on our platform.

faqs.question: How do I become a seller on Asian Spices?
faqs.answer: We welcome authentic suppliers! You can apply by clicking the "Become a Vendor" link in our website footer and submitting your verified business details and KYC documents.

faqs.question: How and when do vendors get paid?
faqs.answer: Vendor payouts are processed strictly on a monthly basis. Sellers receive their earnings after the month closes; mid-month withdrawals are not permitted.

faqs.question: Who handles customer complaints for vendor products?
faqs.answer: To ensure a consistently excellent customer experience, the platform handles all customer service inquiries and complaints. However, repeated customer complaints regarding a specific seller's products will result in the suspension of that vendor's account.

category.name: Category Questions
category.description: Questions about Spices, Kitchen Appliances, and Foods & Beverages.

faqs.question: Where do your spices come from?
faqs.answer: All our spices are completely organic and sourced directly from authentic farms across India and Pakistan.

faqs.question: Are your spices certified organic?
faqs.answer: Yes, they are grown using traditional organic farming practices without synthetic chemical inputs.

faqs.question: Do these spices contain any artificial coloring?
faqs.answer: No, all spices maintain their completely natural colors with zero artificial dyes or visual enhancers.

faqs.question: Are there any preservatives added to ground spices?
faqs.answer: No, our products are 100% pure whole or ground spices without chemical preservatives.

faqs.question: How should I store these spices to keep them potent?
faqs.answer: Store them in airtight glass jars inside a cool, dry, dark pantry away from stove steam and sunlight.

faqs.question: What is the typical shelf life of your ground spices?
faqs.answer: Ground spices remain at peak flavor for 1 to 2 years if stored correctly in airtight conditions.

faqs.question: Do whole spices last longer than ground spices?
faqs.answer: Yes, whole spices (like peppercorns and cardamom pods) retain their oils and flavors for up to 3–4 years.

faqs.question: Are your spices gluten-free?
faqs.answer: Pure spices are naturally gluten-free, but check individual packaging details for allergen cross-contamination notes.

faqs.question: Can I buy spices in bulk or wholesale quantities?
faqs.answer: Yes, bulk ordering options are listed directly on the product variations dropdown menu on our spice list page.

faqs.question: Are these spices irradiated?
faqs.answer: No, our organic spices are cleaned and processed naturally without irradiation treatments.

faqs.question: What is the difference between your regular and premium spice grades?
faqs.answer: Premium spices feature higher natural oil concentrations, stronger aromatic profiles, and larger whole sizes.

faqs.question: How do you ensure the purity of your ground turmeric and chili?
faqs.answer: Every batch goes through strict laboratory testing at the origin to ensure there are zero adulterants or heavy metals.

faqs.question: Are your spices allergen-safe?
faqs.answer: They are packed in facilities handling traditional agricultural goods; check product descriptions for specific cross-contamination warnings.

faqs.question: Why does my organic spice look slightly different from my last order?
faqs.answer: Natural, un-dyed organic crops vary slightly in color and texture depending on the seasonal harvest conditions.

faqs.question: Are any anti-caking agents added to prevent clumping?
faqs.answer: No, our spices are pure. Mild clumping can happen naturally in high humidity and is solved with a gentle shake.

faqs.question: Do you offer traditional spice blends (like Garam Masala) or just single ingredients?
faqs.answer: We offer both raw single ingredients and authentic regional spice mixes formulated using traditional recipes.

faqs.question: Can these spices be traced back to specific farming regions?
faqs.answer: Yes, our sourcing batches are fully traceable to agricultural clusters in India and Pakistan.

faqs.question: Are your spice packages resealable?
faqs.answer: Most of our spice bags come with secure zip-lock closures to retain maximum freshness after opening.

faqs.question: Is your spice handling facility safety-certified?
faqs.answer: Yes, our processing partners maintain international food safety and hygiene certifications.

faqs.question: How can I tell the harvest date of my spices?
faqs.answer: The harvest season and packaging dates are clearly printed on the reverse label of every single item.

faqs.question: What kinds of kitchen products are allowed to be listed here?
faqs.answer: Our platform catalog exclusively allows items falling under our core categories: kitchen utilities, food, spices, and recipes.

faqs.question: Do electrical appliances come with an official warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes, all electrical appliances feature a standard 1-year manufacturer warranty against defects.

faqs.question: What is covered under the kitchen appliance warranty?
faqs.answer: The warranty covers internal component failures, motor issues, and electrical issues, but excludes physical accidental damage.

faqs.question: Are the appliances set to the correct local voltage specs?
faqs.answer: Yes, all models are built directly for standard regional household voltage and plugs without adapters.

faqs.question: Can I purchase official spare parts or replacement blades?
faqs.answer: Yes, replacement components for popular grinders and blenders are listed in our utility accessories section.

faqs.question: Are the plastic elements in your blenders and choppers BPA-free?
faqs.answer: Yes, all food-contact surfaces on our kitchen utilities are strictly certified 100% BPA-free.

faqs.question: What should I do if an appliance stops working after a few uses?
faqs.answer: File a warranty claim directly through your platform dashboard, and we will arrange a diagnostic check or replacement.

faqs.question: Can heavy-duty mixers grind hard whole spices like cinnamon sticks?
faqs.answer: Models rated 750W or higher are designed specifically for heavy whole-spice grinding. Check item specs.

faqs.question: Are the stainless-steel parts rust-resistant?
faqs.answer: Yes, all blades and grinding jars utilize high-grade, food-safe, rust-resistant stainless steel.

faqs.question: Do appliances come with user instruction manuals in English?
faqs.answer: Yes, detailed user setups, operation manuals, and safety guides are enclosed in every retail box.

faqs.question: Are these kitchen appliances dishwasher safe?
faqs.answer: Removable glass jars and non-electrical blending accessories are generally dishwasher safe; refer to your item guide.

faqs.question: How can I verify if an appliance brand is authentic?
faqs.answer: We work directly with manufacturers and certified dealers. Every appliance ships in original brand retail packaging.

faqs.question: What happens if an appliance arrives with missing accessories?
faqs.answer: Report the missing part to support within 48 hours, and we will ship the missing accessory out right away.

faqs.question: Are there any industrial or commercial-grade appliances here?
faqs.answer: Our main catalog features home consumer products, but high-capacity units are explicitly tagged as "Commercial Grade."

faqs.question: How energy-efficient are the electric cookers and food processors?
faqs.answer: Energy star ratings and wattage draws are detailed on every single product specification table.

faqs.question: Can I return a kitchen appliance if I simply don't like the color?
faqs.answer: Yes, provided it is completely unused, unboxed, and within our standard 14-day return window.

faqs.question: Do mixers and grinders have automatic thermal overload cut-offs?
faqs.answer: Yes, most high-torque spice grinders include built-in safety switches to prevent motor burnouts.

faqs.question: Can I get a product demonstration video for complex appliances?
faqs.answer: Yes, product pages include embedded video guides and step-by-step video walk-throughs for operation.

faqs.question: Are non-stick coatings on pans and cookers safe and non-toxic?
faqs.answer: Yes, all non-stick utility items use certified PFOA-free coatings that are completely safe for high-temperature cooking.

faqs.question: Who handles repair services after the 14-day window but within the warranty?
faqs.answer: The platform facilitates coordination with authorized brand service centers under your warranty contract.

faqs.question: What types of items are available in the Foods & Beverages section?
faqs.answer: This category features authentic traditional snacks, shelf-stable ingredients, specialty grains, teas, and drinks.

faqs.question: Are your packaged foods Halal certified?
faqs.answer: Yes, food items sourced from India and Pakistan carry clear, valid Halal certifications visible on packaging graphics.

faqs.question: How do you guarantee that food items don't arrive expired?
faqs.answer: Our warehouse system automatically flags and bars any items with less than 6 months of remaining shelf life.

faqs.question: Are full nutrition profiles and ingredient lists available online?
faqs.answer: Yes, high-resolution label images and full text ingredient lists are published on every item page.

faqs.question: Do you sell fresh, chilled, or frozen food products?
faqs.answer: No, our store exclusively handles premium shelf-stable dry foods, pantry essentials, packaging mixes, and beverages.

faqs.question: Are there any specific vegan or vegetarian filters available?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can filter items easily using the dietary checkboxes on our side navigation panel.

faqs.question: How are glass bottles and fragile items protected during shipping?
faqs.answer: We use custom-fit thick cardboard frames and heavy-duty bubble columns to avoid shipping leakage.

faqs.question: What should I do if a food package arrives unsealed or leaking?
faqs.answer: Do not consume it. Contact platform support immediately with a picture to receive an instant replacement.

faqs.question: Are there sugar-free beverage alternatives in your store?
faqs.answer: Yes, we offer various unsweetened herbal teas, traditional drinks, and low-calorie organic beverage options.

faqs.question: Are your traditional teas sourced from single-origin estates?
faqs.answer: Our premium tea selections clearly indicate their regional estate origins (such as Assam or Darjeeling) on the label.

faqs.question: Do any food items contain common allergens like nuts or soy?
faqs.answer: Allergens are bolded in the ingredient texts, and cross-contamination facility notices are listed on product pages.

faqs.question: Can I buy multi-packs or bundle deals on food items?
faqs.answer: Yes, specially priced multi-packs and ingredient bundle kits are regularly updated across our catalogs.

faqs.question: Are your traditional juices and squashes pasteurized?
faqs.answer: Yes, all bottled commercial beverages are fully pasteurized to maintain absolute safety and shelf stability.

faqs.question: How are traditional sweets (Mithai) packaged to maintain freshness?
faqs.answer: Sweets are vacuum-sealed in food-grade industrial trays to prevent oxidation and moisture damage.

faqs.question: Are your rice varieties aged?
faqs.answer: Our premium Basmati rice options are traditionally aged for 1–2 years to ensure long, non-sticky grains.

faqs.question: Do you stock MSG-free cooking pastes and sauces?
faqs.answer: Yes, the vast majority of our gourmet culinary pastes focus on all-natural ingredients with zero added MSG.

faqs.question: Can I buy readymade traditional recipe spice kits?
faqs.answer: Yes, our recipe-mix category features pre-measured spice packs containing complete step-by-step cooking guides.

faqs.question: What is the country of origin for the packaged snacks?
faqs.answer: Every snack item clearly states whether it was manufactured and packed in India, Pakistan, or locally.

faqs.question: Are there low-sodium food alternatives available for diet restrictions?
faqs.answer: Yes, specialized low-sodium salt alternatives and salt-free spice blends are accessible via search filters.

faqs.question: Can I find organic flours (Atta) and grains on your site?
faqs.answer: Yes, we carry completely organic whole-wheat flours, lentils, and pulses imported directly from organic farms.

faqs.question: How do I place an order?
faqs.answer: Simply add items to your cart, proceed to checkout, enter your shipping details, and complete your payment.

faqs.question: Can I cancel my order?
faqs.answer: You can cancel your order within 2 hours of placing it. After that, it is processed for shipping.

faqs.question: Can I change my delivery address after ordering?
faqs.answer: No, for security and fraud prevention, delivery addresses cannot be modified once an order is confirmed.

faqs.question: How do I apply a discount code?
faqs.answer: Enter your promo code in the "Discount Code" box at checkout and click apply.

faqs.question: Why is my promo code not working?
faqs.answer: Codes may be expired, one-time use, or inapplicable to clearance items.

faqs.question: Can I combine discount codes?
faqs.answer: No, only one discount code can be applied per order.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit/debit cards and standard digital wallets at checkout.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum order quantity?
faqs.answer: No, there is no minimum order requirement.

faqs.question: Will I get an order confirmation?
faqs.answer: Yes, an email confirmation with your invoice will be sent immediately after purchase.

faqs.question: Can I add items to an existing order?
faqs.answer: No, you will need to place a new, separate order for additional items.

faqs.question: Why was my payment declined?
faqs.answer: Declines are usually due to incorrect billing addresses or bank security blocks. Please contact your bank.

faqs.question: Is VAT included in the price?
faqs.answer: Taxes and VAT are calculated at checkout based on your state and country tax laws.

faqs.question: Where can I find my invoice?
faqs.answer: You can download your official invoice directly from your account order history.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to order?
faqs.answer: You can checkout as a guest, but an account lets you track orders and save payment methods.

faqs.question: Can I order over the phone?
faqs.answer: For security reasons, all orders must be placed online through our encrypted checkout.

faqs.question: What happens if an item goes out of stock after I order?
faqs.answer: We will notify you immediately and issue a full refund for the out-of-stock item.

faqs.question: Do you offer wholesale pricing?
faqs.answer: Yes, bulk and wholesale options are available in the product variations dropdown.

faqs.question: Are the prices in my local currency?
faqs.answer: Yes, our site displays prices in your local currency based on your IP address.

faqs.question: How do you prevent fraudulent orders?
faqs.answer: We use automated payment screening and manual verification for high-value orders.

faqs.question: Can I pre-order out-of-stock items?
faqs.answer: We do not accept pre-orders. You can sign up for "back in stock" email alerts.

faqs.question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
faqs.answer: Not at this time, but items are securely and neatly packaged.

faqs.question: Can I leave a delivery note?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can add delivery instructions during the checkout process.

faqs.question: How do I reorder a past purchase?
faqs.answer: Go to your account dashboard, view past orders, and click "Reorder."

faqs.question: Why did my cart empty itself?
faqs.answer: Carts may clear if your browser session expires. Logging in saves your cart automatically.

faqs.question: Can I send an order to multiple addresses?
faqs.answer: No, you must place separate orders for each distinct delivery address.

faqs.question: Do you ship internationally?
faqs.answer: No, currently we do not offer international shipping. We only fulfill domestic orders.

faqs.question: Can you ship to India or Pakistan?
faqs.answer: No, we source from there, but we do not ship retail orders internationally.

faqs.question: How long does standard shipping take?
faqs.answer: Standard shipping usually takes 3-5 business days.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Click the tracking link in your shipping email or enter your order number in your account dashboard.

faqs.question: Who is responsible for lost packages?
faqs.answer: The platform assumes full responsibility for packages lost in transit by our couriers.

faqs.question: What if my package says delivered but I can't find it?
faqs.answer: Please check with neighbors or your building manager. If still missing after 24 hours, contact support.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss my delivery?
faqs.answer: The package will return to the store keeper, and your payment will be refunded to your account.

faqs.question: Will courier call me before delivery?
faqs.answer: Couriers typically send an SMS notification on the day of delivery.

faqs.question: Do you deliver on weekends?
faqs.answer: Weekend delivery depends on the local courier schedules in your area.

faqs.question: Can I expedite my shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, 1-2 day expedited shipping is available at checkout for an extra fee.

faqs.question: Why is my tracking link not updating?
faqs.answer: Tracking can take up to 24 hours to update after the package leaves our facility.

faqs.question: Do you ship to P.O. boxes?
faqs.answer: No, we require a physical residential or business address for delivery.

faqs.question: What is the shipping cost?
faqs.answer: Shipping is calculated at checkout based on package weight and your location.

faqs.question: Do you offer free shipping?
faqs.answer: Free shipping promotions are occasionally run; check the banner at the top of the homepage.

faqs.question: Are fragile items protected during shipping?
faqs.answer: Yes, glass and liquid items are wrapped in reinforced bubble columns and custom-fit boxes.

faqs.question: Why was my order split into two boxes?
faqs.answer: Items sourced from different warehouse zones are shipped separately to ensure faster delivery.

faqs.question: Do I pay double shipping for split orders?
faqs.answer: No, you are only charged the single shipping fee shown at checkout.

faqs.question: Can I change my delivery speed after paying?
faqs.answer: No, delivery speeds cannot be altered once the order is in the system.

faqs.question: What if my package is delayed?
faqs.answer: Weather and logistical delays happen. Check your tracking link for updated ETA alerts.

faqs.question: Can I pick up my order in person?
faqs.answer: No, we operate strictly online and do not have physical pickup locations.

faqs.question: How are spices packaged for shipping?
faqs.answer: They are sealed in airtight, moisture-proof bags or jars.

faqs.question: Will my appliance be shipped in its original box?
faqs.answer: Yes, appliances ship in official retail packaging, placed inside a protective shipping box.

faqs.question: Is signature required on delivery?
faqs.answer: High-value appliance orders may require a signature upon delivery.

faqs.question: My package was damaged by the courier. What now?
faqs.answer: Send us a photo within 48 hours, and we will process a replacement immediately.

faqs.question: Can I route my package to a locker?
faqs.answer: Delivery to smart lockers is currently unsupported by our primary couriers.

faqs.question: Are liquids safe from freezing in transit?
faqs.answer: Our packaging is insulated against standard temperature changes during transit.

faqs.question: What courier do you use?
faqs.answer: We partner with top-tier national logistics providers. The specific courier is shown on your tracking page.

faqs.question: Do you offer contactless delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, couriers default to safe-drop contactless delivery where applicable.

faqs.question: Will I get a text when it arrives?
faqs.answer: Yes, if you provided a mobile number at checkout.

faqs.question: Can I refuse a delivery?
faqs.answer: If you refuse delivery, it goes back to the store keeper and you are refunded (minus shipping fees).

faqs.question: Can opened products be returned?

faqs.question: Who pays return shipping costs?

faqs.question: How long do refunds take?
faqs.answer: Refunds take 5 to 7 business days to appear on your bank statement.

faqs.question: Can customers exchange products?
faqs.answer: Yes, unopened items can be exchanged within the 14-day window.

faqs.question: What happens if a product arrives damaged?
faqs.answer: Contact us with a photo within 48 hours. The platform handles it and will issue a replacement or refund.

faqs.question: Do I need the original receipt to return?
faqs.answer: No, just your 6-digit order number is sufficient.

faqs.question: Where do I drop off my return?
faqs.answer: Once approved, you will receive a return shipping label with drop-off instructions.

faqs.question: Can I return clearance items?
faqs.answer: No, final sale and clearance items are non-returnable.

faqs.question: My spice bag was punctured, what do I do?
faqs.answer: Do not consume it. Send a photo to support for an immediate replacement.

faqs.question: Can I get a refund in store credit?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can choose store credit for an instant refund instead of waiting 5-7 days for bank processing.

faqs.question: I threw away the original box, can I return the appliance?
faqs.answer: No, appliances must be returned in their original, undamaged retail packaging.

faqs.question: How do I know you received my return?
faqs.answer: We will email you a confirmation as soon as our warehouse scans the returned barcode.

faqs.question: My blender broke after 3 weeks, can I return it?
faqs.answer: Returns are only within 14 days. After that, it is covered by the 1-year warranty.

faqs.question: Will you refund my original shipping cost?
faqs.answer: Original shipping costs are only refunded if the platform made an error or the item was damaged.

faqs.question: Can I return a bundle partially?
faqs.answer: No, bundled items must be returned together in full.

faqs.question: What if I received the wrong spice?
faqs.answer: Upload a photo of the incorrect item, and we will dispatch the right one free of charge.

faqs.question: The glass jar shattered, do I need to mail the glass back?
faqs.answer: No! Just send a photo of the damage safely, and dispose of the glass. We will replace it.

faqs.question: Can I dispute a rejected return?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can escalate the case to a platform manager through your support ticket.

faqs.question: How do I start a return process?
faqs.answer: Go to your account dashboard, select the order, and click "Request Return."

faqs.question: Is there a restocking fee?
faqs.answer: No, we do not charge any hidden restocking fees.

faqs.question: Do you provide the return label?
faqs.answer: Yes, a digital label is provided upon return approval.

faqs.question: Can I return items bought with a gift card?
faqs.answer: Yes, the refund will be re-issued to the original gift card.

faqs.question: What if I return an item after 14 days?
faqs.answer: Returns outside the 14-day window are rejected and shipped back to you.

faqs.question: Are recipe kits returnable?
faqs.answer: Only if the entire kit is unopened and the seal is intact.

faqs.question: Can I cancel a return request?
faqs.answer: Yes, simply ignore the label and keep the item, the request will auto-cancel.

faqs.question: Who handles customer complaints regarding returns?
faqs.answer: The platform manages all complaints and return resolutions directly.

faqs.question: My refund is delayed, who do I contact?
faqs.answer: If it has been more than 7 business days, please contact your bank using the ARN number we provided.

faqs.question: Can I return an item because I didn't like the taste?
faqs.answer: No, we cannot accept returns on opened food items based on personal taste preferences.
